Your family doctor in Jamaica Plain, for all ages.

Six doctors, two nurse practitioners and one friendly front desk. Same-day appointments for children and urgent problems, and most visits start on time.

Book a visitOnline in 2 minutes Repeat prescriptionReady in 2 working days Test resultsThrough the patient portal

What we can help with

Most insurance plans accepted, including MassHealth. Call us if you're not sure.

Check-ups

Yearly physicals, blood pressure, cholesterol and general health reviews.

Children's health

Baby checks, vaccines, school forms and same-day visits for sick kids.

Long-term conditions

Regular care for diabetes, asthma, heart health and more.

Women's health

Contraception, smear tests, pregnancy care and menopause support.

Mental health

Talk to a doctor about stress, anxiety, low mood or sleep problems.

Travel and vaccines

Flu shots, travel jabs and advice at least 6 weeks before your trip.

Our doctors

You can ask to see the same doctor each time. Filter by what you need.

Opening hours

Phone lines open at 8am. Lunch hour we stay open.

3150 Centre Street, Boston, MA. Step-free entrance and parking for 12 cars.

For routine visits. If it's urgent, please call.
